'''Grand Admiral Visage The Power of the Darkside''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grand Admiral Visage]]
* '''Published:''' 5 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif|label=Imperial Occupation}}
* '''Strategy:''' Imperial Occupation
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 IOcc Visage DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This an ELITE deck that is not really a deck. It is a list of cards that I have used in several tournaments to win some prizes. The "deck" can withstand a lot of onslaughts before sucummbing to the Power of the Light Side (another ELITE deck)

The published list has 113 cards.

== Strategy ==

There is no stratagey for this deck. If you want a strategy well, tough luck.
I do however suggest you mix-and match with other Effects, Interrupts, and sites because all my sights were DEATH STAR 2.

And look for The Power of the Lightside comming soon. (AKA 20 minutes.)
